name: Adult Protective Services - Refer to Close by Referral Source
description:
This dataset summarizes Adult Protective Services (APS) referrals by referral source, tracking how many referrals were received and how many were found ineligible over time. Each row represents a combination of a reporting period (report_date, recorded as a timestamp at semi-annual intervals such as June 30 and December 31) and a referral source type, including Anonymous, Family Member/Friend/Neighbor, Marshal, Organization, Self, and one additional category. Two count fields capture the volume: total_referred (the number of referrals received from that source in that period) and total_ineligible (the number of those referrals determined not to meet eligibility criteria). The data spans 16 reporting periods and 6 source types, with counts ranging from 15 to over 19,000 referrals per row.

The dataset can be used to compare referral volumes across sources, examine how referral and ineligibility patterns change over time, and calculate ineligibility rates by source or period. It supports trend analysis, resource
